about_the_game: The player lives alone in a house which he must protect to survive. In order to protect his home the player needs to get out of his house and collect resources by picking any location on the map, different places give different resources but the player should be aware that every visit costs valuable time, therefore the player needs to plan ahead in order to survive the nights. While it’s night zombies are outside the player's house so he can’t get any more resources and the player needs to repair all his windows to defend himself against the undead masses lurking outside.

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes blood, corpses, and zombies. There are no sexual acts, and the violence is only superficial.

short_description: Survive alone in your home. By day, gather resources from various locations, each trip costs time, so plan wisely. By night, repair your house and defend it against zombie hordes. Every decision counts in this fight for survival.
